summary: Sandbach United's pre-season preparations are in full swing with just one week until the 26/27 campaign kicks off! The squad has been strengthened with several exciting new signings and one returning player, and the club has also unveiled three brand new kits for the season ahead. With sponsorship opportunities available and the Ramblers looking sharp in their final warm-up matches, there's plenty of reason for supporters to get behind the team as they chase promotion this season.
